description: Find constraints in one schema that contradict each other or can never be satisfied. Reports a NOT NULL column whose default is null, a column declared both NULL and NOT NULL, a CHECK whose numeric bounds no value can satisfy, a scale larger than its precision, a zero-length column, a generated column with a default that can never apply, a constraint naming a column the table does not declare, and a uniqueness requirement another one already implies. Pay 180000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

ddl.description: The schema to audit. SQL text, at most 262144 bytes and 2000 statements. CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, CREATE and DROP INDEX, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, GRANT and REVOKE are read; anything else is listed in not_examined rather than guessed at. No database is contacted and no rows are read, so an arbitrary schema can be audited with no credential and no grant.
ddl.example:
CREATE TABLE invoice_lines (
  invoice_id  integer      NOT NULL,
  line_no     integer      NOT NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  sku         varchar(0)   NOT NULL,
  unit_price  numeric(4,6) NOT NULL,
  quantity    integer      NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT quantity_range CHECK (quantity >= 10 AND quantity <= 5),
  CONSTRAINT sku_present CHECK (sku IS NOT NULL),
  UNIQUE (invoice_id),
  UNIQUE (invoice_id, line_no)
);

name: sql_constraint_coherence_audit

coherent.description: True only when no contradiction was found and every statement was read.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.
